# bioexcel/biobb_dna/biobb_canal

## Summary

Wrapper for the Canal executable that is part of the Curves+ software suite.

The Canal program is used to analyze the curvature of DNA structures.

Nextflow adapter of the [Canal](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/curvesplus.html#module-curvesplus.biobb_canal) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CANAL } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/biobb_canal'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CANAL(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_cda_file` | yes | cda | Input cda file, from Cur+ output |
| `input_lis_file` | no | lis | Input lis file, from Cur+ output |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_zip_path` | yes | zip | zip filename for output files |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Canal properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_BIOBB_CANAL' {
        ext.properties = [itst: 0]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bases` | string | null | sequence of bases to be searched for in the I/P data (default is blank, meaning no specified sequence). |
| `itst` | integer | 0 | Iteration start index. |
| `itnd` | integer | 0 | Iteration end index. |
| `itdel` | integer | 1 | Iteration delimiter. |
| `lev1` | integer | 0 | Lower base level limit (i.e. base pairs) used for analysis. |
| `lev2` | integer | 0 | Upper base level limit used for analysis. If lev1 > 0 and lev2 = 0, lev2 is set to lev1 (i.e. analyze lev1 only). If lev1=lev2=0, lev1 is set to 1 and lev2 is set to the length of the oligmer (i.e. analyze all levels). |
| `nastr` | string | "NA" | character string used to indicate missing data in .ser files. |
| `cormin` | number | 0.6 | minimal absolute value for printing linear correlation coefficients between pairs of analyzed variables. |
| `series` | boolean | false | if True then output spatial or time series data. Only possible for the analysis of single structures or single trajectories. |
| `histo` | boolean | false | if True then output histogram data. |
| `corr` | boolean | false | if True than output linear correlation coefficients between all variables. |
| `sequence` | string | "Optional" | sequence of the first strand of the corresponding DNA fragment, for each .cda file. If not given it will be parsed from .lis file. |
| `binary_path` | string | "Canal" | Path to Canal executable, otherwise the program wil look for Canal executable in the binaries folder. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
